command: cd /code && Rscript -e 'load("/data/ratingData5"); ratingData5$USval <- ifelse(substr(as.character(ratingData5$correspondingUS),1,1)=="p","positive","negative"); ratingData5$USval <- as.factor(ratingData5$USval); ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(likingRating ~ ParticipantNumber * USval * correspondingTime, ratingData5, mean); ratingData5AggrW <- tidyr::spread(ratingData5Aggr, key="USval", value="likingRating"); ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$positive - ratingData5AggrW$negative; print(aggregate(EC ~ correspondingTime, ratingData5AggrW, mean)); print(with(ratingData5AggrW, tapply(EC, correspondingTime, mean)));'
